Read that file in full first, particularly around line 60-70 (the existing import block, where `ZimmProductMeta` and similar ui-kits imports live) and line 891 (the main `<ProductView>` call site).

## The change — exactly this, nothing else

1. **Add one import**, alongside the existing `ZimmProductMeta`/similar ui-kits imports near the top of the file:
```tsx
import { ZimmColourSwatchGroup } from '../../components/ui-kits/molecules/zimmColourSwatchGroup';
```

Check the exact relative path depth needed from this file's actual location and the existing import style used by sibling ui-kits imports in this same file (some may use the `app/` alias instead of a relative path — match whichever convention this specific file already uses for its OTHER ui-kits imports, don't guess; if the file's existing ui-kits imports use `app/components/ui-kits/...`, use that same alias style instead of a relative path).

2. **On the main `<ProductView>` call site — line 891 only.** Do NOT touch the two set/bundle `<ProductView>` instances at lines 801 and 827 — those render child products in a bundle/set layout, a different case, explicitly out of scope for this story. Add exactly one new prop to the line-891 instance:

```tsx
renderVariationAttribute={(attr) =>
  attr.id === 'color' ? (
    <ZimmColourSwatchGroup
      label={attr.name}
      selectedName={attr.selectedValue?.name}
      selectedValue={attr.selectedValue?.value}
      values={attr.values.map((v) => ({
        value: v.value,
        name: v.name,
        href: v.href,
        imageUrl: v.image?.disBaseLink || v.image?.link,
      }))}
    />
  ) : undefined
}
```

Notes on this exact shape, do not deviate:
- `undefined`, not `null`, for the non-colour case — `renderVariationAttribute`'s documented contract (see its JSDoc on `ProductViewProps` in `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/../../components/product-view/index.tsx` — actually it's at `overrides/app/components/product-view/index.tsx`) states that `null` ALSO falls through to the default renderer, but `undefined` is the sentinel this codebase actually uses for "let the default handle it." Using `undefined` here keeps the call site self-documenting even though either technically works.
- `attr.id === 'color'` — stays US-spelled exactly like this, matching the SFCC attribute id. This codebase's Australian-spelling convention applies only to Zimmermann-authored identifiers, not SFCC's own attribute ids — do not "fix" this to `'colour'`, that would break the actual runtime match against real SFCC data.
- `imageUrl: v.image?.disBaseLink || v.image?.link` — this exact fallback chain, matching how base SFCC's own `getVariantValueSwatch` resolves an image URL. When neither exists, `imageUrl` naturally becomes `undefined`, which is exactly the signal `ZimmColourSwatchGroup`'s own AC-5 filter (already built and tested in Step 3) uses to exclude that colour variation. You are not implementing that filter here — it already exists in the component you're calling.
- Confirm `attr`'s actual TypeScript type (`SfccVariationAttribute`, already used elsewhere in `product-view/index.tsx`) has the fields you're destructuring/accessing (`id`, `name`, `selectedValue.name`, `selectedValue.value`, `values[].value/name/href/image.disBaseLink/image.link`) — read that type definition if you're unsure of exact field names before writing this, don't guess and let `tsc` catch it after the fact.

- `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/molecules/zimmColourSwatchGroup/` (Step 3, committed) or `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/atoms/zimmColourSwatch/` (Step 2, committed, including its focus-ring fix).

- `overrides/app/theme/`, `translations/`, `overrides/app/components/swatch-group/` (does not exist, do not create it), `overrides/app/components/image-gallery/`.
